verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own invoicing product, and its API reference lists A/R aging among the financial statements it can generate on demand. That covers the aging-report core of the story. Per-customer receivable balances and an accountant-facing AR tracking workflow are not described anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented per-customer AR balances, in-app (non-API) AR aging report documentation, details of aging buckets and customer breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
